save_checkpoint_model: save a PyTorch model checkpoint to a file with state dict and metadata
save_checkpoint_with_optimizer: save a model checkpoint that includes the optimizer state dict for resuming training
save_checkpoint_with_meta: save a model checkpoint with custom metadata including mmcv version and timestamp
save_checkpoint_pavi: save a model checkpoint to a pavi modelcloud remote storage path
save_checkpoint_multi_optimizer: save a model checkpoint with multiple named optimizers stored as a dictionary
